residual_risk: The preflight reads the head of the policy repository's main unless given a SHA, while the commit set in the project's CI/CD setting is the authority; the setting is not readable without a credential, which the tool does not take, so the two can differ. It needs SSH access to the policy repository and exits non-zero without it unless --offline is given. It reads the records checked for every head and does not check the records that apply to named historical candidate commits. It runs the local Python, ruff and mypy versions, which may differ from the pipeline image. It runs commands read from the policy repository, limited to lines that start with python3, ruff or mypy and contain no shell syntax; a python3 command can still run any Python code the policy repository names, which the protected policy repository is trusted not to do. It does not run the other branches of the job aidf-governance or the security jobs, uses the local origin/main (fetch first) where the pipeline fetches main, and is not a security control. The brief template and the Task Contract fields have presence tests only. The amendment that replaced a mirror list with a lookup follows the Change Owner's stated preference; the contract's Status records it. The attestation lookup reads the records tuple and requires the policy job to check exactly records plus selected records; a policy that attests files by another mechanism fails the lookup closed and needs this tool updated.
